tip.score:
Team score: %s

strength %s
defense %s
offense %s
roles %s
synergy %s
core %s
tip.megas: Suggests mega evolutions (at most one per team). Requires the mega stone.
tip.legendaries: Allows suggesting legendaries and mythicals (including yours) and Ubers-tier Pokémon.
tip.doubles: Double battles (2v2): values speed control, Fake Out, Protect, redirection, Intimidate and spread moves; hazards barely count.
tip.save: Saves this team to look at later (Saved tab). The text in the name field becomes the team name.
tip.apply: Puts the Pokémon of this team that you own into your party, in slot order. Whoever leaves the party goes to the PC. The ones you don't own are skipped.
tip.add:
Adds what is typed to the team (Enter).
Accepts several names: rillaboom, great tusk
tip.click_set: Click to see the suggested set.
tip.click_add: Click to add to the team.
slot.empty_tip: Slot %s is empty. Pick a suggestion or type a name.
empty.no_suggestions: No suggestions with the current options.
empty.cannot_complete: Not enough Pokémon to complete the team.
full.title: Team complete.
full.suggest_hint: See the Analysis tab for suggested swaps, or remove a slot.
full.teams_hint: Remove one or more slots to see other ways to complete it.
analysis.empty: Add Pokémon to the team to see the analysis.
swap.title: Swap %s for %s
raid.title: Raid
raid.help_detect: Stand within 8 blocks of a raid crystal (or join the raid) and click Detect.
raid.help_type: Or type the boss in the field above, e.g. charizard fire (the tera type is optional).
raid.use_typed_tip: Uses the field text as the boss: pokemon [tera type].
raid.detect_tip: Looks for the raid you are in or the nearest crystal.
raid.not_installed: Cobblemon Raid Dens is not installed; type the boss (e.g. charizard fire).
raid.none_nearby: No raid nearby. Stand within 8 blocks of a raid crystal, or type the boss (e.g. charizard fire).
raid.unknown: Didn't recognize the boss '%s'. Use: pokemon [tera type].
saved.title: SAVED TEAMS
saved.none_hint: Build a team and click Save at the top. Tip: the text in the name field becomes the team name.
saved.load_tip: Click to load this team (with the chosen roles).
search.use_as_boss: Click to use as the raid boss.
advisor.title: SUGGESTED SET
advisor.differs: Your Pokémon differs from the suggested set:
form.mega_tip: Mega evolution (needs the mega stone). Only one mega per battle: another mega on the team goes back to normal.
role.click_tip: Click to use this role. It changes this Pokémon's moves and what its teammates need to cover.
iv.title: IVs
iv.all_good_long: The IVs this set uses are already 31.
iv.how: Order based on the current role: stats with more EVs and further from 31 come first.
move.known_long: Your Pokémon already knows this move.
move.swap_long: Already learned: swap it in the moves menu.
note.no_removal: the team has no hazard removal
error.server: Server error while computing suggestions (see the log).
error.no_server: The server doesn't have Team Builder installed.
apply.done: Party updated (%s came from the PC).
apply.in_battle: Can't change the party during a battle.
apply.none_owned: None of the Pokémon on this team are yours.
apply.pc_full: The PC is full; nowhere to store whoever leaves the party.
cmd.pc_summary: %s in party, %s in PC, %s with competitive data
cmd.unknown_names: Didn't recognize: %s. Use Tab to see the names.
cmd.team_full_use_analyze: The team is already complete; use /teambuilder analyze to see swaps.
cmd.no_swaps: No swap from the PC improves the team.
trainer.search_hint: type in the field to search by name or type
trainer.none_hint: Teams come from Radical Cobblemon Trainers. Try another name, e.g. misty, elite, rocket.
trainer.build_tip: Puts the 6 best counters from your PC against this trainer into the slots.
trainer.no_answer: Nobody on your team handles this Pokémon well.
core.title: Active core: %s
core.hint: Suggestions now value Pokémon that benefit from this core.
note.trick_room_iv: Trick Room: 0 Spe IV is ideal
analysis.threats_tip: Strong meta Pokémon your team struggles to handle.
analysis.swaps_tip: Single-member swaps that raise the team score the most.
threat.none: No big threats for this team.
threat.hint: Bigger threat = more weak members, fewer resists and fewer answers.
advisor.tab_set_tip: Suggested set for the chosen role.
advisor.tab_check_tip: What your Pokémon still needs to match the set, checking your inventory.
check.obtain: You don't own this Pokémon yet
check.state_have: You already have what you need in your inventory.
cmd.snapshot_help: /teambuilder snapshot update [month] [doubles] downloads from Smogon; /teambuilder snapshot reset goes back to the bundled one.
